title: Chapter 66: The Alliance'S Arms Set Out
content:
Chapter 66: The Alliance'S Arms Set Out

That night, many lords who joined the alliance will not be able to sleep. The alliance was established in a hurry, and they have to make urgent adjustments to the development strategy of the territory under the new situation.

Wu Qing, as always, returned to his body, dealt with the night's affairs, and fell asleep peacefully.

His short-term and long-term goals are very clear, and he has a very clear plan for the future. Now everything is within his control, and there is nothing to worry about.

The next morning, 3,000 puppies gathered in the Zerg territory set off for the Tiger Territory.

Together with the 2,000 hydralisks and puppies stationed in the Tiger Territory, the 15,000 Zerg troops have arrived.

There are also ten Zerg war horses accompanying the puppies. It is really a bit of a downgrade to let ten Zerg guards walk beside Wu Qing. This time, Wu Qing prepared war horses for them to turn them into heavy cavalry.

After changing this outfit, the level of Wu Qing's guards instantly rose. When going out, face is also very important.

…

Tiger Lord, Wu Qing and Meng both got up early, enjoyed a hearty breakfast, and went to the military camp to review the army.

The main troops going out this time were the Zerg army, and the Zerg army was not very interesting to watch. The two simply walked through the formalities and led the army out of the city.

Today, in addition to the 4,000 elites from the four territories who went out together, many lords of the alliance will come to see off the army.

Not long after Wu Qing and Meng led the army out of the city, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan successively led 1,000 elites and their logistics teams to rush over.

In addition to bringing 1,000 combat troops, they also brought about 1,000 logistics personnel, and the logistics team was full of giant lizards, carrying a large amount of combat supplies.

Wu Qing was a little overwhelmed when he saw this formation.

If these logistics teams are combined with the Zerg army, the marching speed of the entire army will be greatly reduced. With the burden of logistics, it will also affect the combat deployment of the Zerg.

After everyone met and exchanged simple greetings, Wu Qing said to Hu Wei and others: "Bringing so many logistics personnel and supplies will affect the marching speed and combat efficiency."

"Do you think it is possible to streamline the logistics team and only bring necessary supplies and limited logistics personnel to meet the requirements of people and things being able to mount and march quickly? Is there any problem?"

Except Meng, the other lords were a little surprised when they heard Wu Qing's request. They even had doubts in their hearts whether Wu Qing could fight.

"The combat supplies we carry are streamlined, only enough for more than ten days of combat. This is to prevent the Tengu tribe from making things difficult for us in terms of combat supplies."

Hu Wei explained to Wu Qing.

"There is no need to prepare so many days of combat supplies, just bring three days' worth!"

"I will try to finish our battle within three days and bring back your elite troops intact!"

Wu Qing patiently explained that he had his own ideas about this expedition. The Zerg fighting together with other armies did affect the performance of the Zerg.

But the alliance has just been established, and some things have to be compromised, and the Zerg must slowly adapt.

For ordinary people, it is a bit difficult to understand Wu Qing's explanation. Hu Wei and several lords looked at Meng.

"I believe Wu Qing! Let's do it according to Wu Qing's requirements!"

"I have fought with the Zerg. The Zerg is indeed a unique race. We cannot judge their combat methods with common sense!"

With Meng coming out to support Wu Qing, although everyone had doubts in their hearts, they still chose to believe Wu Qing and Meng.

Including Meng, the five lords went to the logistics team and began to command in person. According to Wu Qing's requirements, the logistics team was streamlined.

Wu Qing also went forward one by one to check the situation and give suggestions for adjustments.

After Wu Qing's personal guidance, the five logistics teams were streamlined. Only a small part of the supplies on the back of the giant lizards of each team remained. This reduction in burden can greatly increase their running speed.

Each territory has nearly a thousand logistics personnel, and only less than a hundred elite personnel are left. There are places for them to ride on the giant lizards.

After such a reduction, the five logistics teams have become lightly loaded cavalry units, which can barely keep up with the speed of the combat troops.

Seeing such a logistics team, the other lords except Meng are a little depressed.

At this time, many lords in the alliance have come. According to their common sense, a 20,000-man army with such a small amount of logistics supplies is not enough for a meal for the army.

"Don't worry, my Zerg troops will not consume these logistics supplies."

Wu Qing knew everyone's concerns and comforted them with a smile.

At this point, everyone can only choose to believe. After all, Wu Qing doesn't look like an unreliable person and will not joke about such things.

3,000 Zerg puppies arrived, and all 20,000 troops were present.

15,000 ferocious and terrifying Zerg troops, five elite teams of 1,000 people with different styles, and four powerful lords with different temperaments, these are the lineups representing the alliance this time.

The army only needs to wait for an order to set off.

However, it is already late, and no one has seen the shadow of the Tengu clan's support personnel.

Meng only knows the approximate location of this battle. The specific location and how to arrange the 20,000 troops still need the Tengu clan to support and arrange.

Otherwise, if the 20,000 troops just rushed over, who knows what kind of situation they would face.

The time for the pick-up agreed yesterday was this morning, and it is already morning.

"The Tengu clan is too arrogant! We paid such a huge price to send troops to participate in the war, but they are so slow to send people to pick us up!"

"I am really worried that the lords who went out to fight will be harassed by the Tengu clan!"

"It's really too much! At most, we can defend the territory ourselves. Even if we die in battle, it is more refreshing than to suffer this bird's anger!"

"..."

Many lords have begun to speak sweet words.

Wu Qing and Meng and other lords did not complain. They were mentally prepared for the Tengu clan's difficulties.

Wu Qing learned some of the Tengu clan's situation from Meng. He felt that Meng's judgment was correct. The Tengu clan was indeed inferior to the previous generation, and now they no longer had the spirit of a big clan.

In this duel with the evil god camp, the Tengu clan's hope of winning was very slim.

This may also be the reason why many independent lords with a certain vision are unwilling to become vassals of the Tengu clan.

Killing the enemy cleanly is indeed better than relying on others and dying in a miserable way.

When the sun was high, the army waited for nearly two hours, and a team of about a hundred kobold knights riding giant lizards, led by the rat lord yesterday, arrived late.
